articleTitle: Influence of opinion leaders on dynamics and diffusion of network public opinion
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Network public opinion (NPO) has two mechanism to spread: internal spreading mechanism is the internal opinion evolvement process, which explores the mechanism of how NPO evolves from chaotic individual opinion at the initial moment to consensus, polarization, or clusterization; external spreading mechanism is the process of the external influence pervasion, which focus on how NPO spread from a few individuals to a broad range group in a short time. As a kind of distinctive individuals, opinion leaders have a major impact on both processes. This paper introduces a new model of continuous NPO dynamics with opinion leaders by modifying the Weisbuch-Deffuant model and analyzes the diffusion of NPO under the influence of opinion leaders based on SIR model and the complex networks. It is found that the NPO is more likely to be polarized when there're opinion leaders in the group especially when the leader's initial opinion is of great extreme, and as the rich nodes on the spreading networks of NPO, opinion leaders with the connection between them are of great importance in pushing the diffusion of NPO.

articleTitle: A simulation-based method for evaluating the reliability of vehicle routing schemes in the vaccine delivery with vehicle breakdown
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper introduces the vehicle routing problem of the vaccine delivery with vehicle breakdowns. In the delivery process of vaccines, a continuous low-temperature environment is required. Once any event that causes the temperature to rise happens during the whole process, the quality of vaccines cannot be assured, and even human lives that are injected by the vaccines are threatened. Therefore, this paper presents a method to evaluate the reliability of vehicle routing schemes in the vaccine delivery with vehicle breakdown. The method adopts the simulation idea and supposes breakdowns at every fixed time interval for each vehicle. When a supposed vehicle breakdown happens, a saving-based heuristic will be applied to generate a rescue scheme. Finally, the method was coded and run on one of the classical CVRP instances.

articleTitle: A multi-state reliability analysis of single-component repairable system based on phase-type distribution
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This research investigates the multi-state reliability of single-component repairable system, considering maximal/minimal repair pattern. We assume that the operational and repair times of the system follow continuous Phase-type distribution, instead of exponential distribution or others typical distributions, which make the reliability model more adaptive to describe real situations. The proposed model provides the analytic formulas of the availability, up and down periods of system, mean time between failures (MTBF) and mean time to repair (MTTR). Finally, numerical examples are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Grey multi-level risk evaluation of China's oil import
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The main purpose of this study is to reveal the influence factors of oil import to avoid the risk of oil import effectively. First, risk evaluation indices of oil import are screened and determined. Then the grey multi-level combination evaluation model is established. And it is used to evaluate the China's oil import risk. The evaluation results show that China's oil import risk is higher. The calculation leads us to the conclusion that the price risk and transport risk of China are both higher. Obviously, the main factors of China's oil import are price and transportation. So they are should be focused on in the future. It is necessary for us to take measures to avoid risks, to minimize the loss of imports, and to ensure China's oil import.

articleTitle: Research on the interdependencies between commute mode choice and trip chaining behavior
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the analysis of travel survey data, this paper developed and applied the mixed binary-multinomial choice modeling method to the exploration of the relationship between travel mode choice and trip chaining behavior of home based commute. The analysis is carried out from two directions, namely trip chaining to travel mode, and travel mode to trip chaining. The developed model takes into consideration the effects of interdependencies between trip chaining and travel mode choice on each choosing behavior, which emphasizes the guidance of decision mechanism on travel behavior forecasting. The results show the pattern that trip chaining drives mode choice is the dominating trend. This means that travelers first decide how to organize different activities and travel into trip chains based on individual and family needs and then make travel mode choice condition under the limit of trip chaining. These findings have important implications for travel demand forecasting and for the design and carrying out of demand management measures.

articleTitle: Systematic layout planning: A study on coal mine facilities
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With information age approaching, for the fierce competition between enterprises, the large-scale machinery plants, such as the coal mine, begin to apply the scientific and lean management with modern technology. The sound layout is instrumental in controlling cost and increasing efficiency, so the managers think highly of the ground and transportation system layout of coal mine, as has become a newer research field. The coal mine, with the designed output of 900 thousand tons per year, is located in a mountain area, and because of the complex terrain and limited space, it is significant to layout the coal mine properly. This article analyzes the characteristics of the coal mine in Shanxi province, China, with Systematic Layout Planning (SLP), to project the optimal layout pattern. First the coal mine is divided into some related operational departments, and their relationship among departments is evaluated after the analysis of work flow, logistics and non-logistics, so the comprehensive closeness of each department can be qualified. Then the departments are arranged according to the closeness rank calculated. Finally, the optimized layout plan is obtained according to on-site fieldwork. The finding contributes to the coal mine with limited space.

articleTitle: The relationship between entrepreneurial learning and entrepreneurial knowledge
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As more and more research on entrepreneurship, entrepreneurial learning has taken increased attention in the entrepreneurship literature, which has been an interest among scholars. Learning and knowledge is typically related, therefore, entrepreneurial knowledge is involved in various studies of entrepreneurial learning, but the present study examining the relationship between entrepreneurial learning and entrepreneurial knowledge has few in details. This paper draws on from the organizational learning theory and knowledge management theory, combs the existing literatures and finds that scholars follow two views about the relationship between entrepreneurial learning and entrepreneurial knowledge: entrepreneurial learning is a process of knowledge development, along with knowledge acquisition, sharing, integration and utilization; entrepreneurial learning generates entrepreneurial knowledge, which may also contribute to the acquisition, the integration, and the use of knowledge; and finally, the article briefly describes the deficiencies of the current research, in order to provide future rigorous research and development in practice.

articleTitle: A model for studying public opinion hotspot growth regulation in microblog network
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Regarding the problem of microblog growth regulation of net-mediated public sentiment in the propagation process, a complex-network-based modeling approach was proposed. Taking microblog as a research object, by using the approach of growing, adding edge and random adding edge to reflect the characteristics of user's behavior and microblog public opinion dissemination, a microblog net-mediated public sentiment growth mode was built. By using Matlab toolkit, a simulation model was built. Through running this simulation model according to different network scale experiment cases, for example, setting parameters of the initial nodes size and the random adding edges, diagrams could be layout, that illustrating network, degree distribution and probability distribution. Simulation results validated the model's feasibility for studying network public opinion hotspot growth regulation.

articleTitle: Path selection mechanism of cluster innovation on strategic emerging industries
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Cluster innovation is a new advanced form of co-innovation with a strong impetus to the development of China's strategic emerging industries. Based on the connotation of cluster innovation, as well as the relationship between the industrial chain, value chain and knowledge chain, this paper selects three aspects, the path dimensions, the originating conditions and selection modes to discuss the path selection mechanism of the cluster innovation of strategic emerging industry, proposes four quadrants of dimension selections, four originating conditions and four options, and finally concludes implementation of cluster innovation should be based on development characteristics of different industries.

articleTitle: Research on the interactive effect of media attention and trading volume on stock return
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Recent researchers have found stable relationship between media attention and stock price, trading volume as well as liquidity, but rare study focus on the interactive effect of media attention and trading volume on stock return. Our research bases on the listed bank stocks in China, uses the Baidu index data, and drive a panel data analysis. We find that there is a negative relationship between media attention and stock return, and a significant interactive effect of media attention and trading volume on stock return, that is, the effect of media attention on stock return increases when the trading volume increase. In the future, we will study the differences between countries to find more information about the effect, which can also enrich this research.

articleTitle: A new method of defining divergent opinions in group decision-making
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Owing to different personal preferences, knowledge backgrounds and life experience of decision experts, divergent opinions always exist in group decision-making, and influence the assembly of the final opinions in varying degrees. Therefore, the determination and treatment of divergent opinions appear to be extremely important. For the existing divergent opinions in group decision-making, this paper proposes a new method. Firstly, in each of the alternatives, we calculate expert closeness degree matrix (the matrix consists of all the close degree between any two expert opinions) based on the concept of closeness degree in fuzzy theory. Secondly, in the light of the extent of disagreement, we take different treatment methods accordingly. Finally, the processed group opinions are synthesized by the evidence combination formula. The new algorithm defines the divergent indexes and divergent experts in order to modify the divergent opinions pointedly, and it is implemented in MATLAB, reducing the amount of computation and the waste of resources.

articleTitle: The incentive mechanism of recommendation behavior in the mobile social network
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The recommendation behavior from the consumer to potential consumer is one of the effective ways, which even affect the sound development of mobile commerce industry. In this paper, we construct a decision-making model of recommendation behavior to compare the behavioral choices under rationality and reciprocity, and also analyze the influence of reciprocity preference and referral reward program on recommendation behavior and the incentive effect. The results indicate that the effect of reciprocity on the level of effort about recommendation is not absolutely positive, and it may come into being negative effect. Given the reciprocal preference of the agent, the more important for improving effort-rate is to increase the reciprocity parameter, and to improve the assessment of kindness term that potential consumer response to consumer.

articleTitle: Earnings management research based on the stakeholder perspective — From the empirical analysis of listed companies in China
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Earnings management has always been one of the main means to polish performance reports of listed companies. As most interests' stakeholders' understanding of the company is from the financial report, the earnings management motivation from managers will exist for them to affect decision-making of stakeholders in listed companies. This paper, considering the participation of stakeholders, and the relationship between earnings management and senior managers, executive officers, supervisors, shareholders, creditors, suppliers, distributors, employees, government and community; found out that executives, independent directors positively related to the earnings management, suppliers, shareholders, directors and creditors is negatively related to the earnings management through the empirical analysis. But supervisors and distributors is not significantly related with earnings management. According to the phenomenon of earnings management, it also divided stakeholders' into three types as stakeholders' incentive, constraint and comprehensive. And accordingly, it also put forward different earnings management advice from the perspective of three types.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the relationship of CSR and CFP based investors' reaction: Evidence form Chinese stock market
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Following the instrumental stakeholder theory, we present hypotheses about the relationship of CSR and CFP based investors' reaction. This research reveals that investors can declare their attitude to CSR by buying or selling stocks of companies which taken CSR actions, and these investors' behaviors can affect CFP. In the part of empirical research, we take the publications of South Weekend CSR ranking as focal event and examine hypotheses by the method of event study. The results of data analysis show that investors' attitude to CSR is positive and the companies which engage in CSR action will be rewarded by investors through abnormal returns in stock price. The empirical results support the hypothesis that CSR can affect CFP positively through investors' reaction.

articleTitle: A high-dimensional vine copula approach to comovement of China's financial markets
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Multivariate copulas are commonly used in economics, finance and risk management. This paper is concerned with applications of vine copulas to comovement of financial markets. We give a broad view of the problem of modeling comovement using vine copulas. We show to the practitioner the advantages of modeling through vine copulas. All steps (model selection, estimation, validation, and applications) are given in a level reached by all data analysts. Finally, the comovement of China's stock markets are studied by C-vine and D-vine Copula.

articleTitle: Impact of empowering leadership behavior on communication satisfaction and its mechanism
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Staffs' communication satisfaction has been deeply recognized, leadership behavior impacts organizational internal staffs' communication satisfaction. This study discusses how the empowering leadership behavior impacts the communication satisfaction and its mechanism of action. Four manufacturing enterprises in Heilongjiang province were selected to fill in questionnaires. After that, we used multivariate statistical analysis methods for the empirical research. The results show that: empowering leadership behavior has a positive impact on communication satisfaction; communication openness mediates the relationship between empowering leadership and communication satisfaction. Therefore, organization leaders can improve staffs' communication satisfaction by cultivating new organization culture atmosphere that all people participating actively. At the same time, project decision-making groups should be set up. Managers can also set incentive systems to promote employees' responsibility.

articleTitle: Innovation development of Russian economy: Challenges of decade
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The current status of the Russian economy, its role in the international division of labor and status of innovational potential leave much to be desired. Overcoming of these negative tendencies is possible only under activation and development of venture innovative activity, creation of new forms of innovative infrastructure. An innovative type of development involves variation and updating of forms of activities in accordance with shifts in the technological base, values, stereotypes of the production and consumer behavior in society and business entities, with any changes in the socio-economic system and its links with the outside world

articleTitle: Study on risk early warning system of asphalt concrete pavement design
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: There are a lot of uncertainty risk factors in the design of highway asphalt concrete pavement. The design is affected not only by the various uncertain factors of the design phase, such as reliability, and pavement construction, but also of using stage, such as vehicle overloading etc. Being traditional pavement design theory not availably considering the uncertain risk factors, so it is resulted the quality risk of asphalt concrete pavement design. A large number of cases of early damage of asphalt pavement, by the uncertainty risk factors, is the exemplification. On the basis of the risk characteristics of the asphalt concrete pavement design and the risk management theory, the paper has put forward the early risk warning system in the design of highway asphalt concrete pavement, and has structured the early warning index system. And then, studied and proposed the risk warning threshold and the warning limit of the asphalt concrete pavement design. Based on extension theory, established the early risk warning model of the asphalt concrete pavement design, and illustrated the specific application of the model. Finally, briefly introduce the early risk warning computer system. With the early risk warning system, the risk warning state of particular design can be evaluated overall and systematically. So, according to the warning state of design quality risk, it is able to guide the designers to modify or redesign, as well as optimizate the original design results. By this procedure, it is realized to improve the existing design theory and reduce the quality risk of asphalt concrete pavement design.

articleTitle: Does the external knowledge environment matter? A study on firms' learning processes and performance under different knowledge environmental conditions
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Following a process-based view of learning, this article aims to discover whether firms selectively activate different learning processes to optimize innovation and financial performance under different knowledge environments. Data from a survey of Chinese firms confirms the above hypothesis. It contributes to the literature by confirming empirically that firms do not usually activate all learning processes because of resource constraints. Besides, this article further details what combinations of learning processes firms use as the tacitness of their knowledge environment varies. This lends important insights into how firms survive the tension between resource constraints and learning. Another contribution of this article is that by integrating an organizational antecedent-communication - into this research, it is able to capture the “systematic” change in knowledge processes.

articleTitle: The land prices and housing prices — Empirical research based on panel data of 11 provinces and municipalities in Eastern China
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In recent years, the land and housing prices continue to rise, and has become an important livelihood issue of social concern and the focal point of government's macro-control. Almost all the media and public will blame the excessive growth of house prices on the supply of real estate. Besides, there are sudden huge profits in real estate. However, the increasing price of land is the main reason of the high housing prices. This thesis analyzed the relationship between the land prices and housing prices based on the data of 11 provinces and municipality in eastern of China during the period from 2002 to 2009, found out the significant impact of the land prices. So then drew the people's attention to the issues of current land management system, and put forward proposals for reform of it.

articleTitle: Measurement of IT returns on firm with multiple production processes by simultaneous production functions
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In practice, returns on investments in IT cannot be directly verified and it is difficult to identify the proportion of the shared IT budget allocated to each stage for multiple production process. In order to measure the IT returns on each stage directly, this paper proposes a simultaneous production functions model for the multiple production process connected in series. This model can be used not only to identify the impact of IT on firm performance, but also to estimate the technical efficiencies of each stage for multiple production process. It can be shown that the difficulty of identifying the shared inputs in each production stage will disappear with this new model when those decision making units have the same allocation of IT budget.

articleTitle: Can export control win the competition edge of a country's high technology sector: Based on the view of the enterprise to recoup the capital outlay
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to maintain technological leadership and economic advantages, to protect national security, a country usually control the export of some products, especially high-tech products, however, does export control really work? This paper tries to answer this question from the view of the enterprise to recoup the capital outlay. The results showed that, too strict high-tech products export regulation is not good for the enterprise to get its return on investment, and thus cause a series of bad effects. Export regulation on high-tech products should be maintained to a certain extent, so the enterprise can get its return on investment in time, besides, the products need to be controlled for export should be materials used for making these high-tech products, if not, the export regulation may cause some bad effects.

articleTitle: A study of knowledge representation of construction claims based on ontology
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Introduced the ontology theory into the domain of construction claims, this paper proposed ontology-based knowledge representation of construction claims to resolve the problems about the incompleteness representation and sharing difficult of the domain knowledge of claims. Based on the claim knowledge of the formal definition, this paper described the definition of the claims concepts, the attributes and relationships, and built the claims ontology through protégé 4.2, and with the OWL ontology language to describe the methods of the ontology established, and expound establish the feasibility. The research results show that the ontology method can be effectively expressed the knowledge of the domain of construction claims, which will promote the further study of the domain of construction claims knowledge reasoning and knowledge reuse.

articleTitle: A framework for using six-sigma metrics to evaluate the performance of supply chain
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Quality management or six sigma management mainly focuses on internal organization. This paper carries forward six-sigma metrics, especially nonconforming rate into supply chain domain to develop a framework which evaluates the delivery performance of the entire supply chain and its all related processes. The proposed framework is different from other conventional performance evaluation methods. The proposed framework uses the sample data to calculate the nonconforming rate. Futhermore, the corresponding sigma level for the delivery performance can be obtained through the standard normal distribution table. The model presents a unique opportunity in identifying the current status of supply chain, taking corrective actions and increasing the customers' satisfaction. A case study is given to validate the proposed framework, and which is about a multinational home applications manufacturer's supply chain network.

articleTitle: Could HR practices help to foster sustainable employee energy in the work?
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The paper aims to clarify the relationship between human resource (HR) practices and performance. Based on the self-determination theory, we developed and tested a theory of how human resource practices affect employee psychological empowerment and resultant employee energy in the work in this study. A survey of 227 employees from different companies showed that the human resource practices were positively related to the employee psychological empowerment including the feeling of meaning, impact, autonomy and competence. In turn, employee psychological empowerment played partial mediating role between human resource practices and employee energy in the work. Taken the 80's and 90's generation employees into account, results of the analysis indicated that employee energy in the organizations are influenced by the individual psychological condition significantly. The meaning, impact, autonomy and competence employees perceived in the work are related to the higher level of energy in the work.

articleTitle: Study on layout optimization of the iron and steel industry in the Bohai Sea rim area based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The iron and steel industrial output and the corresponding wastewater of 44 cities in the Bohai Sea rim area in 2007 were selected in this research. And the spatial layout of the iron and steel industry in the Bohai Sea rim area was studied with spatial analysis method which includes the exploratory spatial data analysis. The spatial relationship between the output value of the iron and steel industry and wastewater discharge of the cities around the Bohai Sea was revealed though analyzing each space local contact indicators. This research puts forward the ideas of further optimizing the spatial layout of the iron and steel industry in the Bohai Sea rim area from the angle of reducing wastewater. It is also meaningful for the development of the iron and steel industry in the Bohai Sea rim area.

articleTitle: Logistics scheduling with due date assignment and batch delivery
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper aims to study the logistics scheduling with due date assignment and batch delivery. A set of orders needs to be processed by the manufacturer and delivered to the customers upon completion. Each customer has a specific acceptable lead time. The manufacturer assigns a due date for one order by negotiating with the customers. The problem is to assign appropriate due date for the orders, and find a joint schedule of order processing at the manufacturer and order delivery from the manufacturer to the customers that minimize the total cost. The objective is to minimize the total tardiness penalty, due date assignment and delivery costs. For this problem, we analyze the complexity of the general case and study the solvability of multiple case by providing efficient algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on classification of suppliers of high-end equipment manufacturing enterprises based on the degree of interdependence
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the characteristics of suppliers of high-end equipment manufacturing enterprises (HEME), it is necessary for HEME to implement supplier classification management. The paper selects the degree of interdependence as a classification perspective and builds a classification model of HEME suppliers. According to the producer's dependence on the supplier and the supplier's dependence on the producer, the classification indicators of HEME suppliers are defined. A typical high-end equipment manufacturing enterprise is used as a case study. The empirical study is conducted by using the K-means clustering analysis method. The empirical results show that interdependent suppliers, supplier-oriented suppliers, independent suppliers and producer-oriented suppliers do exist in HEME. The paper conclusions provide important reference and guidance for HEME implementing supplier classification and managing suppliers.

articleTitle: Study of active auto after-sale service model under new situation
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The increase will boost the Chinese aftermarket dramatically, reflecting the fact that the focus in automotive industry will be shifted from vehicle sales to after service. Up to now automotive aftermarket of China has been enlarging, but the level of Chinese automotive aftermarket still fall behind compared with the developed countries. Active after-sale service means to provide timely communication and help. This paper expounds the connotation of auto after-sale service and analyzes the current situation and problems of auto after-sale service in China. Then we come up with the new application and significance of active service. On this basis, we propose a new service model combining active service with auto after-sale service based on customer analysis by using some algorithms.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of the relationship between sci-tech innovation platform and innovative city
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The aim of the study is to reveal the inter linkages between sci-tech innovation platforms and innovative city construction. 110 sets of laws and regulations have been quantified to analyze the evolution of sci-tech innovation platforms. It shows that there is a marked growth on the policy quantity and dynamics after 2006 the innovative country goal proposed. Then an empirical analysis has been done by comparing the quantity of sci-tech innovation platform in nine cities of Fujian province with four core indicators of the innovative city evaluation index system. Research shows that there is a positive correlation between sci-tech innovation platform and innovative city which suggests that the promotion of the construction and management of science and technology innovation platform will promote the development of innovative city.

articleTitle: Accident management reinforcing with qualitative and quantitative analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Accident analysis is an important component in risk management, however in nowadays, with the growing of complex plant and work procedure, identifing causing factor is impractical. In this paper, we proposed to use qualitative and quantitative methods to building base for risk management analysis and reinforcement. An analytic hierarchy process is conducted to build the accident chain, and the judgment degree is further project into probabilities indicates the chance of event occurring. Based on the constructed accident structure, a Bayesian Network analysis is applied, providing a view from statistics an uncertainty. Based on this, a 7S management framework was used in reinforcement analysis. A chemical accident case study is present to valid the proposed methods.

articleTitle: The software project progress measurement frame based on GQM model
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the GQM model into software project progress measurement frame, which makes the software project progress controllable and prevision. Here has fully explained GQM model, while introducing the software measurement steps. And, based on a factual Gantt chart, this paper has finished a series of particular GQM measurement plan and measurement structure. Consequently, a measurement indicator is got, analyzing and summarizing the measurement results. Well, it is provided that all of this paper is greatly valuable for the software practicable activities.

articleTitle: The evaluation and comparative analysis on the capacity of strengthening province through S&T based on factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the era of knowledge economy, Strengthening province through S&T(SPST) is the goal pursuit by provinces and the basis for building an innovative country. This paper established the evaluation index system of SPST from 4 aspects including 11 indexes and used the factor analysis method to evaluate and compare the SPST capacity of domestic 30 provinces. The results shows that it have significant difference in capacity of SPST, strength of SPST play the key role which base on S&T effect and performance.

articleTitle: The effect of margin level on the stock index futures market
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Since the CSI 300 index futures launched by the China Financial Futures Exchange in 2010, stock index trading has become another central issue in domestic financial research. This study determined the theoretical relationship between the margin level and market trading volume by using the definition of margin liquidity cost in a mathematical analysis model, and derived the general conclusions about the connection of market margin and market liquidity and volatility on the theoretical point. Furthermore, the study verified the validity of the theoretical conclusions by using the real trading data of S&P500 index futures contracts. At last, this article concludes: stock index futures margin level has a positive impact on the liquidity of the stock index futures market, and a reverse impact on market volatility.

articleTitle: Creative design for market segments: Application of Kansei engineering to the design management
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, Semantic Differential Method was introduced into design segmentation research based on the theory of market segmentation and Kansei engineering, so as to quantitatively study on the measurement of aesthetic differentiation among consumer groups, and discuss related strategies of product design. Through empirical research, the corresponding relationship between consumer groups and Kansei semantics of products was established; the feasibility of guiding design segmentation by assessing the Kansei images of product was examined. Therefore, this paper provides some valuable suggestions for the design management and creative design.

articleTitle: Prediction model of mortgage prepayment risk
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Due to the change in bank's attitudes towards mortgage prepayment risk, as well as increasing valuation needs for the mortgage-backed securities, the prediction on individual mortgage prepayment behavior is becoming more and more indispensable. This paper analyzes the main factors influencing Chinese mortgage-loan prepayment from a modeling perspective. Based on unexpected events, sale, inheritance and other investment income, a prepayment prediction model was established to assist commercial banks in managing the individual mortgage effectively, and to hasten the development of Chinese mortgage-backed securities.

articleTitle: Research on disaster assessment methods and integrated information systems based on GIS grid
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Firstly this paper summarizes the model of the disaster loss calculation based on GIS grid, and then develops a regional disaster assessment information system based on WebGIS. Using the space grid as the computing unit, grid-based disaster damage assessment model gives us a new way to analyze and process the disaster geospatial data and the socio-economic data on the unit grid. It can express the process of the disaster dynamically. This paper elaborates the method of the grid-based disaster loss calculation. Then we have discussed the development objectives and function design of the integrated system. Finally, combined with ArcGIS Server platform we have developed a system and as a result conducted a scenario simulation and grid-based damage assessment experiments on several major disasters. It has got a good result.

articleTitle: Study on the sensitivity of R&D funds investment fluctuations in the eastern part of China
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the sensitivity of R&D funds investment fluctuations in the eastern 11 provinces and cities part of China. The data we used is that the eastern provinces and cities' R&D funds investment growth and the national R&D expenditures growth during the period of 2001-2011. By the method of β-coefficient this study shows that: firstly, compared to the national R&D funds investment fluctuations, the volatility of R&D funds investment fluctuations are relatively larger whether in the eastern part of China, or in the central and western areas. Secondly, from the eastern part of 11 provinces and cities, the highest sensitivity of R&D funds investment fluctuations are in Hainan Province and Hebei Province, while the lowest sensitive degree of R&D funds investment fluctuations is in Guangdong Province; And also, there are the less volatile of R&D funds investment in Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Shandong, Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions; For surprisingly, the R&D funds investment volatility in Fujian Province and Liaoning Province are more stable.

articleTitle: Stochastic rough normal distribution multi-criteria decision-making method based on SRN-WAA operator
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper investigates a multiple attribute decision making problem, whose attribute values are stochastic rough normal distribution. We define stochastic rough normal distribution variables, and then propose rules and stochastic rough normal distribution aggregation operator (SRN-WAA). The method based on SRN-WAA operator is proposed for the problem of the incomplete information on attribute's weights and it's values in terms of random variables. In order to confirm the optimal criterion weights, we use the attribute's variance and attribute's weights which obey normal distribution to establish optimization. And it uses SRN-WAA operator to integrate criterion for obtaining the alternative's evaluation of estimate. Besides it receives the sequencing of the mean of alternatives by means of comparing composite evaluation. Finally, a numerical example shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The game analysis of knowledge sharing behavior of knowledge alliance taking into the consumer
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: After the knowledge alliance set up governance committee, the Governance Committee and the alliance member enterprise will form a double game, furthermore considering knowledge alliance's customers will form a three-game. This paper discusses these two games and gives assumptions and solution. Finally, the article draws conclusions: on the one hand the knowledge alliance governance committee should increase the punishment to the free riders and take responsibility for their own negligence, on the other hand should raise the awareness of knowledge sharing between the alliance member enterprise and customer to more effectively promote management and development of the knowledge alliance into a virtuous cycle of sustainable development.

articleTitle: A study on the relationship between different technological absorptive capacities and R&D investment in joint R&D
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Joint R&D is an important way of technological innovation, this research will introduce enterprise technological absorption capacity by R&D cooperation game analysis, we build two phases of three enterprise joint R&D game models, to solve the equilibrium of joint R&D behavior under the enterprise different technological absorption capacities, and give three kind of situations to discuss the relationships between enterprise technological absorption capacity differences and the R & D investment behavior.

articleTitle: The effect of information disclosure of internal control reports on the stock market — An empirical analysis based on event study method
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Between February and April 2012, all the companies which both listed at home and abroad disclose their internal control reports and internal audit reports to the society for the first time, according to the internal control supporting guidance of the enterprises. The content and influence of the internal control evaluation reports become the attention focus for academic circles, enterprise and government. By using empirical analysis based on event study method, we prove that the condition of information leakage of the annual reports and internal control reports is very serious. In addition, there is much abnormal return existed near the time when the reports disclose. At the same time, by using Paired Samples T Test, we find that the fluctuation of the stock price is mainly caused by the disclosure of annual reports. The influence of internal control reports is rather small. To sum up, the internal control reports are more likely to be the supplementary information for the annual reports. Information disclosure of internal control reports is insufficient and vague. Moreover, the standards of the internal control reports need to be refined and the internal control construction of the enterprise remains to be developed.

articleTitle: The relations between IPO initial returns and price update in Chinese growth enterprise board
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper uses the Chinese GEB IPO data from October 2009 to December 2012 to shed light on the autocorrelation of both initial returns and price update and the relations between the initial returns and price update. We find that both initial returns and price update are cyclical. These two variables are positively related. The equal-weighted average monthly initial returns are significantly positive related to the subsequent 3th month IPO price update. However, we don't find that there exists the partial adjustment effect in Chinese GEB IPO pricing. Considering the determinants, the bigger firms tend to have higher price update. The initial returns are significantly positive related to turnover and market returns during the 30 days prior to the offering.

articleTitle: The impact of MNE's CSR on its branch performance
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Few research conducted Multinational enterprise CSR in foreign context and emerging markets. It also remains unclear the link between social practices and product market performance at the branch level in the multinational context. To understand (1) does Multinational enterprise CSR in host country influence their branches' performance in emerging market; (2) how the spatial distance between home and host countries of Multinational enterprise impacts the relationship between Multinational enterprise CSR and their branches' performance in emerging market. We empirically examine the Multinational enterprise CSR and market performance in China. Our results show that 1) branches' CSR performance is positively associated with sales comparing with domestic average level of industry in host country. 2) The greater the spatial distance between the home and host country of foreign affiliates, they less likely benefit from CSR effort.

articleTitle: Study on R&D flexibility dimensions of high-tech enterprises
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the continuous advance of globalization and the rapid development of science and technology, environment faced by firms is increasingly complex and dynamic, which has a deeper and deeper effect on firms' development. It is especially significant that aggravation of competitive environment dynamism and complexity intensify for high-tech enterprises day by day, so the improvement of R&D flexibility foundation of high-tech enterprises need to be paid close attention. R&D flexibility of high-tech enterprises is researched in this paper. First, starting from the concept of high-tech enterprises R&D flexibility, the role that R&D played in the activities of high-tech enterprises is analyzed, and the implication of R&D flexibility for enterprises is put forward. Then, based on analysis above, significance of high-tech enterprises R&D flexibility is demonstrated. Finally, dimensions of high-tech enterprises R&D flexibility are proposed: updating agility of technology, product diversity and innovation ability, through literature review of the flexibility factors and R&D elements.

articleTitle: Research on airport apron service based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: One of the reasons for the airport ground delay is the apron unreasonable arrangement, so arranging apron operating services reasonably and reducing ramp time have the practical significances. The particle swarm optimization is introduced into the scheduling problem, combined with the actual operation situation of the apron. Through studying reasonable arrangement of vehicles, this paper reduces the overall ramp operating hours. By using particle swarm optimization algorithm, the paper finds the optimal position of each vehicle and the location of the global optimum, then the flights sequences that the vehicles should serve are obtained and the service progress is found. The longest working time of the single vehicle is the minimum service time for this kind of services. This paper establishes the mathematical model of the vehicles, based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The simulation calculation results show the feasibility of this method. Through the optimization, the operating hours are shorter and the apron operating time is reduced, which will make departure time more reliable.

articleTitle: Optimization of the multi-objective dynamic cell formation problem considering machine sharing
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The design of cell formation of a cellular manufacturing system (CMS) is a combinatorial optimization problem. Cellular manufacturing can reduce the material handling costs and increase the efficiency of the system. Because of uncertainties in production life circle, there are many changes in demand of the products. But former cell formation methods ignore this situation. And product life cycles are shorter and shorter, and demand volumes and product types are hard to forecast. Thus, cell design needs to be suitable for different periods. Dynamic cell formation is a solution of this problem. In this paper, a multi-objective model of Dynamic cell formation is presented to optimal the relocation cost, machine utilization and intercell moves. Besides this, the situation that some machine need be shared at more than one cell at the same period is also considered. To solve the mathematical model, a genetic algorithmis applied and two numerical examples are presented to evaluate the validity of this model.

articleTitle: Study on urban niche taking the urban agglomeration in northern slope of tianshan mountains as a case
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, the authors define the conception such as urban niche at the beginning, based on the niche theory. Taking urban agglomeration in Northern Slope of Tianshan Mountains as a case then, the niche breadth model and differentiation index model are used to analyze the breadth and structure changes of urban niche, and the interaction relations between each other in the urban agglomeration. The main data used in this paper include demographic data, industry figures and investment data from 1980 to 2010. According to the analysis, it shows that: 1 In the urban agglomeration, the population niche of Urumqi and Shihezi are higher than other cities, while the economic niche and resource niche of Urumqi and Karamay are the two front-runners. It indicates that urban niche is incontinuous. 2 As to economic niche, the niche breadth of city with maximum value is 32 times bigger than the city with the minimum in the urban agglomeration, which indicates that the difference of niche breadth within the urban agglomeration is huge and the polarization effect of central city is prominent in aspect of economic and social development. 3 The population, economic and resource niche differentiation indices show the downward trend, which indicate that the spatial imbalance of population and economy are improving and the gap between population and economic development is gradually diminishing. It also means that the urban agglomeration is gradually transforming from single-center into multi-center urban agglomeration. According to the characteristics of cities in the Northern Slope of Tianshan Mountain and the requirements of the specialization and cooperation, the idea of dislocation development in allusion to the urban agglomeration is put forward at last.

Author Keywords: urban agglomeration in northern slope of Tianshan Mountains

articleTitle: Analysis of the cross market conduction mechanism of the risk of foreign disinvestment
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The outbreak of the global financial crisis in 2008 and China's more strict foreign capital policy have led to the hither to unknown dilemma for foreign capitals. More and more foreign disinvestment occurred and it has brought a great risk to the development of China's economy. This essay establishes a cross market disinvest risk conduction model, analyses the conduction mechanism of the risk of foreign disinvestment between financial market and the real economy, and then explores the conduction effect of the risk of disinvestment. In the end, in order to ease or isolate the divestment cross-market risk conduction and to reduce the impact that disinvestment leads to the economy of the host country to the least, several immunization strategies are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on the self-organization evolution of project organization system
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Organization research is the most important aspect in project management, introducing system science to the new paradigm of organizational research is the trend of organization theory. This paper analyzes the connotation of project organization on the basic of systematic thinking, demonstrates that project organization system is a typical self-organization system from the aspects of open, instability, nonlinearity and fluctuation, and then describes the process of self-organizing evolution. Through the analysis of Haken model, this paper finds out that evolution of project organization system mainly depends on the state of control parameters and order parameters. So as to the evolution of project organization system should take reasonable guidance on the basis of self-organizing theory in order to promote self-improvement fleetly and achieve win-win between participating organizations in the system.

articleTitle: Optimal decisions and capacity coordination with joint contract in service supply chain
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper discusses the contract model for a three-stage service supply chain which consists of a service demander, a service integration supplier and service suppliers with a contract service supplier and some temporary suppliers. It is proposed a joint contract of compensation and revenue sharing for the mathematical model. Our contribution in the case of meeting the uncertain demands of market is to promote the capacity level by stimulating suppliers which have to refrain from the waste of overcapacity. The relationship between profits, quantity of service capacity and variables for coordinating both upstream and downstream companies in the supply chain is discussed through numerical analysis and simulation. It is proved that capacity has connection with price, cost and contract parameters. The results show that enterprises can obtain optimal profits simultaneously at an approximate capacity level and the joint contract is able to coordinate the service supply chain.

articleTitle: Nonlinear prediction of exchange rate: A new approach to multiple time series analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This article offered an effective method to forecast daily exchange rate. Based on the inspecting and discriminating the nonlinearity structure of the exchange rate system, we use univariate and multivariate singular spectrum analysis for predicting the value and the direction of changes in the daily pound/dollar exchange rate. In prediction of daily pound/dollar rate, we use the rescaled and bootstrapped daily euro/dollar rate as a guidepost for the singular spectrum analysis method. We use the random walk model as a benchmark to evaluate performances of the singular spectrum analysis as a prediction method. Empirical results show that the forecast based on the multivariate singular spectrum analysis compares favorably to the forecast of the random walk model both for predicting the value and the direction of changes in the daily pound/dollar exchange rate.

articleTitle: The influence of institutional executive mode on procedural justice
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this study, the pattern of institution of execution is divided into two types, one is institutional determined which means results were determined by institution, and the other is authority determined which means results were determined by authority's decision. The study examines the influence of two institutional executive modes on procedural justice judgment and outcome acceptance. The study use scenarios as experimental material, present the scenarios to the college students, to explore how two sorts of institutional executive mode have effect on procedural justice. Study 1 manipulate institutional executive mode through scenario, the result suggests that when the outcome was determined by institution, the score of the procedural justice judgments and outcome acceptance were significantly higher than the outcome was determined by authority. Study 2 present procedural justice or procedural injustice scene to the participations; invite them to fill in the institutional executive mode questionnaire. The result suggests that under the procedural justice scene, the scores of the institutional determined was significantly higher than the procedural injustice scene. However, under the procedural justice scene, the scores of the authority determined were significantly lower than the procedural injustice scene. The result of the two studies indicate that the degree of the authority participation influence the individual's procedural justice judgments during the institutional executive process. Thus in real organizations, we should strengthen the culture of institutional determined, and in the process of institution implementation, we should pay more attention to the role of the institution itself. Strengthen the scientific and procedural aspect of institution; Improve the effectiveness of institution executive from the institution itself.

articleTitle: The empirical research between FDI and the third industrial agglomeration in Jiangsu province
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This article aims to explore the deeper relations between FDI and the third industrial agglomeration. Seven typical industries of the third industry in Jiangsu are selected as the example. Based on the relations between FDI and the seven industries' industrial agglomeration, we analysis the relation between FDI permeability and the industry agglomeration degree empirically. Meanwhile, metering methods such as Granger causality test, regression analysis and linear regression equation are used to get the conclusion which differs from the general ones, namely FDI impacts the industrial agglomeration differently for different industries. And FDI and the third industrial agglomeration is not always positively related, the impact factor can be either positive or negative.

articleTitle: Relations between work value, work stress and employee performance: Moderating effect of perceived organizational support
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this study, we surveyed 505 employees and their immediate supervisor, and try to investigate the relations between work value, work stress, job performance and perceived organizational support. Through statistical analysis, we find that work stress has a mediating effect between work values and employee performance; perceived organizational support is a moderator between growth value and work stress, which will strengthen the relations between security value and work stress. While the moderating effect of perceived organizational support between security value and work stress is not proved.

articleTitle: Construction method of a reconfigurable Process Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: To be aimed at the demand of knowledge contexture's diversity and dynamic scalability in the process of Knowledge Management, a method of constructing reconfigurable PKM (Process Knowledge Map) is presented. Firstly, the hierarchical process knowledge contexture model supporting heterogeneous contextures and the process knowledge unit model based on six-tuple knowledge structure model are constructed, respectively, on macro-level and micro-level. Then a kind of flexible model of process knowledge map is constructed through the integration of macro-and micro-level model, the logic of reconstructing the process knowledge map which is based on the flexible model is proposed, and the process knowledge map reconfigurable algorithm is established. Finally, this paper demonstrates the rationality and validity of the method proposed above through constructing an instance of PKM.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation on multiple constraint factors of city underground space development and utilization
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to solve the existent problems of incomplete and ambiguous information during the evaluation on the multiple constraints factors of city underground space development and utilization, this paper applies analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to construct the comprehensive evaluation index system of the multiple constraint factors of city underground space development and utilization, then Yuzhong district, Yubei district, Beibei district in Chongqing respectively as an example, and comprehensively to evaluate the multiple constraint factors of city underground space development and utilization. Example analysis shows that, it has high feasibility and effectiveness that applies the method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to the multiple constraint factors of city underground space development and utilization, and it can contribute to solve fuzziness and uncertainty problems of the evaluation process.

articleTitle: The VRIO characteristics of corporate strategic human capital at business level
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Strategic human capital as the unique resources brings competitive advantages for enterprises, which is unquestionable. Because of different strategies at business level, strategic human capital characteristics are different. This paper, firstly, through exploratory factor analysis surveys the strategies at the business layer of 435 enterprises, two different types of enterprises under the cost leading strategy and product differentiate strategy are implemented respectively; secondly, based on the structural equation theory for two kinds of enterprises it establishes structural equation to analyze and compare the V (value), R (rarity), I (inimitability) and O (organization), the four areas of strategic human capital characteristics; finally, adopting the analysis findings that on the base of not ignoring the value (V) of employees, when take the measure of cost leadership strategy, the corporate strategic human capital better equipped with the rarity (R) and the inimitability (I) characteristics; however with the product differentiation strategy, the corporate strategic human capital characteristics of the rarity(R), the inimitability(1) and the organization(O) are more important.

articleTitle: SD modeling and simulation of the oil-economy-environment system in the west region
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The sustainable development of western economy is inseparable from the strong support of energy and environment system. This paper researchs 11 provinces, cities and autonomous regions in western China and creates a simulation model of petroleum-environment-economy system by the method of SD. The simulation model shows the basic model and the rapid model oriented by pursuing economy growth are not sustainable. Compared with the basic model, coordinated development model and the guaranteed growth mode have taken the sustainable development, rational development and utilization of energy resources and protection of the ecological environment into consideration. Besides, both of them can reduce the gap of supply and demand of petroleum resources in western region and improve the effectiveness of its support to the sustainable economy development.

articleTitle: Modeling closed loop supply chain system based on stochastic fuzzy Petri net
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: A new approach to model and analyze closed loop supply chain system is proposed based on Petri net theory. The approach proposed consists of two stages. In the first stage, the closed loop supply chain is modeled as a stochastic fuzzy Petri net model with conventional stochastic Petri nets in which the transition firing rates are characterized as fuzzy variables. In order to obtain the reachablility graph of the stochastic fuzzy Petri net, the fuzzy expected values of the transition firing rates are calculated and the stochastic fuzzy Petri net model is degenerated as a common SPN in the second stage. Then the degenerated Petri net is isomorphic to a continuous-time Markov chain. A numerical example analyzing the performance measure of closed loop supply chain system is given to show the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: The optimal pricing of E-commerce market with network externalities
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: So far, two-sided markets theory is one of the latest hot and frontier in the research of the international industrial organization theory. In this paper, under the condition of inter-group externalities and intra-group externalities in the two-sided market pricing model, we will be researching for the impacts on the basis of inter-group externalities and intra-group externalities in the two-sided market pricing strategy, getting the optimal equilibrium solution: The optimal pricing given by the monopoly platform, which can maximize the manufacturer's Profits; The optimal consumption, which consumed by the bilateral user groups. Furthermore, the results also point out that the inter-group externalities and intra-group externalities have a relationship with the optional equilibrium, which have an important significance for the development of the platform operators.

articleTitle: Actuarial present values in continuous annuities based on Hossian Assumption
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Continuous life annuities have an important role in life insurers, and it is necessary to utilize a fractional age assumption when we calculate the actuarial present values of these life annuities. Obviously, the rationality of the assumption decides the calculation accuracy. Comparing with other used assumptions, the death information of the life table can be utilized more adequately under this assumption. At the same time, we can obtain the continuous mortality force in all life time if this assumption is used, and this assumption also has other good geometric properties. Hence, Hossion Assumption can improve the estimated accuracy of fractional age mortality rates. Based on Hossian Assumption, the actuarial present values (abbreviated to APVs) of three continuous life annuities are discussed. We obtain the calculation expressions of these APVs based on Hossian Assumption. In addition, using the experience life table of the Chinese Pension (2000-2003) (male), the numerical calculations are carried out respectively. And we compare the results with ones under UDD assumption.

articleTitle: When do corporate diversification increase financial liquidity?
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Different from the existing literatures mainly focus on the value effect of corporate diversification, our paper analysis and examines how corporate diversification affect financial liquidity, and wheher there exists difference under different property condition. The results show that, corporate diversification decrease cash holdigns in general, which indicates that the diversiciation strategy and cash holding policy are complementary in creating financial liquidity, there is liquidity effect of diversification. However corporate diversification would not increase the marginal value of cash holdings, which indicates the liquidity effect of diversification is not effective. When consider the effect of property, we find that diversification decrease cash holdigns significantly, while increase the marginlal value of cash holdigns significantly when financial is constranined and corporate governance is good in non-state-owned corporations. But we find the opposite results in state-owned corporations, Which indicates the liquidity effect of diversification is effective relatively in non-state-owned corporations. The contribution of our paper is filled the blank of literaure in the diversification's liquidity effect based on China evidence, which will enrich and expand the study on the relationship between diversification and financial policy.

articleTitle: An artificial bee colony algorithm for fuzzy portfolio model with concave transaction costs
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the financial market, the expected rates of security returns cannot be well reflected by historical data because of the high volatility of market environment. This paper deals with a fuzzy portfolio selection problem based on possibility theory. Due to ignoring transaction costs would result in inefficient portfolio, a possibilistic portfolio selection model with concave transaction cost is proposed. In addition, Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) Algorithm is an optimization algorithm based on the intelligent behavior of honey bee swarm. To solve this nonlinear programming, the ABC algorithm is utilized. Finally, we illustrate the new model by a numerical example and compare results with Genetic Algorithms (GA), which shows that the ABC algorithm is more effective and powerful than GA.

articleTitle: Research and application of comet technology in public logistics information platform
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the development of our economy and the strengthened foreign communication, logistics industry faces more and more intensive competition while having very rapidly development. It is necessary to build the public logistics information platform(PLIP) to meet forth stricter requirements for the instantaneity and accuracy of logistics information. But most Web-based systems are based on the original Web or Ajax model which is limited by web's request/response architecture, and clients need to send requests frequently to refresh server-side data with low efficiency, high bandwidth consumption and bad user experience. In order to overcome these weaknesses on data synchronization and real-time, we apply pushlet, an open source Comet framework, to the PLIP in this paper, and implement real-time logistics data push in the “server push” way. The result shows that it can ensure timeliness and correctness of information, and in the same time reduce the consumption of network bandwidth. The PLIP using Comet will improve the management efficiency, save the logistics costs, and promote resource integration in logistics industry.

articleTitle: Impacts of leadership styles on new venture performance
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Leadership styles and induced conflicts are essential to an enterprise and its performance; therefore, it is of paramount significance to study the impacting mechanism of leadership and conflicts on new ventures' performance. By building an intermediation model with three variables of conflicts, leadership styles and new venture performance, a study was conducted on the intermediation of different conflicts (i.e. task conflict and relational conflict) between leadership styles (i.e. transformational and transactional leadership) and new venture performance. Confirmatory factor analysis, regression analysis, and intermediate test are adopted to demonstrate the intermediation of task conflicts between leadership styles and new venture performance. Both transformational and transactional leadership have a positive effect on the new venture performance, and the former has a more striking effect; there is a remarkable positive correlation between task conflict and the new venture performance. Recommendations are made for new ventures in their management.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of international crude oil price fluctuation and oil import to China's GDP
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In recent years, China's degree of dependence on foreign oil has been getting higher and higher. The fluctuation of international crude oil price has an enormous influence on China's import of crude oil, which continually shocks the economic development of China. In this paper, the Markov Property of international oil price fluctuation is proven, and Markov Chain's stable State Transition Probability is calculated. Under each Markov state, the GDP cost about every import policy is calculated. Finally Linear Programming Model is build which can get the optimal import policy. By the model, this paper estimates that the fluctuation of the international oil price can cause a loss about 47.078 billion Yuan to GDP in a single month. Besides, we get some decision making methods according to the state of international oil price. Finally, based on the research, four suggestions to oil importing are put forward in the paper.

articleTitle: Case studies of seeking the motives of merger and acquisition between enterprises by using efficiency theory
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Horizontal merger refers to mergers and acquisitions (later same as M & A) between enterprises which belong to an industry, producing and operating same or similar products. The main purpose of the M & A is expanding its market share, generating economies of scale. In this paper, from a new perspective, the event study method was used to study the motivation of M & A enterprises through the case of Midea Electric Appliances acquisitions Little Swan. Verify merger motives of the Midea electrical appliance and Little Swan accord with efficiency theory. Through analyze three common effects of the efficiency theory (management synergies, operating synergies and financial synergies), further explain the application of efficiency theory in the horizontal merger and acquisition motives between enterprises, and eventually come to convincing conclusions.

articleTitle: The sort analysis and application of interval number DEA efficiency set model
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The system relative Effectiveness evaluation under uncertainty factors is the frontier of DEA Theory, research on DEA model with fuzzy elements can help resolve problems of the uncertainty input-output in systematic evaluation. From the perspective of efficiency set, the paper studied the DEA evaluation when the inputs and outputs were interval numbers, and proposed an interval number DEA efficiency set model and its sort method. With the help of the research, we can sort DMUs when they were IDEA efficiency, IDEA fuzzy efficiency and IDEA non-efficiency. Besides, the paper analyzed the application of interval number DEA efficiency set model in business performance evaluation, and pointed out the attentions of evaluating, which can help managers to apply the IDEA model in business performance management better.

articleTitle: Analysis of enterprise technology innovation ability based on the interpretative structural modeling
publicationTitle: 2013 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 20th Annual Conference Proceedings
